acceptance: strikes_after is computed from distinct decisive digests, including the current one
A test covers a restart on an unchanged patch that does not add a strike
description: report.finalize adds one to the plan's strike count for every DO NOT SHIP and writes it as strikes_after and into the retry state, and the plan takes the max of history and state. Two cases add a strike for a patch already counted: a base or tier restart on an unchanged patch, and runs with an unreadable diff (the "unread-<head>" digest is unique per head). A pull request can then be refused before three DO NOT SHIP decisions on distinct patches. Deferred from #2784 (Low).
